messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:

    earlier: Page Yuki for anything on Cinder this cycle, not Diego Alvarez, as of 2025-07-22. [decision; valid 2025-07-22 to 2025-08-29; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-07-22]
    earlier: Page Diego Alvarez for anything on Cinder this cycle, not Yuki Tanaka, as of 2025-06-13. [decision; valid 2025-06-13 to 2025-07-22; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-06-13]
    earlier: Page Yuki Tanaka for anything on Cinder this cycle, not Diego, as of 2025-02-17. [decision; valid 2025-02-17 to 2025-06-13; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-02-17]

    earlier: The product catalog lives with the Cinder team as of 2025-01-17. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-10-20; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17]
- Team Cinder's on-call swapped on 2025-12-15, with Yuki carrying the Cinder on-call phone. [decision; valid 2025-12-15 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-12-15]
    earlier: Team Cinder's on-call swapped on 2025-11-25, with Diego carrying the Cinder on-call phone until the next rotation. [decision; valid 2025-11-25 to 2025-12-15; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-11-25]
- Marcus Oyelaran picked up the Team Atlas on-call shift from Priya on 2026-04-14. [decision; valid 2026-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-04-14]
- Lena carries the Boreal on-call phone as of 2026-02-04, after the on-call swap that morning, until the next rotation. [decision; valid 2026-02-04 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-02-04]
- The product catalog has a deploy window on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC as of 2025-11-12. [constraint; valid 2025-11-12 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-11-12]
    earlier: The product catalog has a deploy window on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-05-02 to 2025-11-12; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-05-02-2]
